title: Curve stabilizers and identity-reducing dual-number automorphisms
statement: Let k be a field, Omega an algebraically closed field and a:Spec Omega -> Spec k a morphism [def-weil-field, def-weil-algebraic-closure]. For any proper algebraic-space curve family X over a [def-sfb-proper-curve-moduli], there are its classifying based functor x, a group scheme G locally of finite type and quasi-compact over Omega, and an algebraic space Z over k with p:Z -> Spec Omega representing the moduli automorphism space of x [lem-sfb-algebraic-stack-dm-point-stabilizer]. For every full open U, membership of X in U is equivalent to x factoring through U [def-sfb-open-moduli-substack]. Chartwise unramifiedness of p is equivalent to unramifiedness of G -> Spec Omega [def-weil-unramified-morphism]. Finally all dual-number points of G over Omega reducing to its identity are the constant identity point if and only if X has trivial infinitesimal automorphisms, using the literal cartesian-presheaf pullback and infinitesimalReduction of [def-sfb-proper-curve-moduli]. No smoothness or reducedness of G is required.

proof.text: Restrict X along Spec Omega -> Spec k using the slice-site equivalence with sheaves over the represented base. Its properness and dimension bound follow from IsProperCurveFamily, with dimension tested on the identity geometric point. Apply the proper-curve automorphism representation theorem to obtain the separated finite-type group scheme G and its restriction-natural group isomorphisms. Use cartesian lifts of X to form its fibred Yoneda functor x.

source.place: Tags 0DSQ and 0E6G, first proof paragraph; categories.tex fibred Yoneda lemma; stacks-morphisms.tex Tag 0DSN

proof.text: Evaluation of x at the identity scheme recovers X up to its cartesian comparison isomorphism. For a full open U a factorization of x therefore implies membership of X. Conversely closure under arrows puts all its cartesian pullbacks in U, giving a factorization. Regard G as an algebraic space over k with map p to Spec Omega. Its representing isomorphisms and fibred Yoneda identify sections on every test scheme with vertical natural automorphisms of x. Restriction naturality is exactly IsModuliAutomorphismSpace.

source.place: Tags 0DSQ and 0E6G, first proof paragraph; categories.tex fibred Yoneda lemma; stacks-morphisms.tex Tag 0DSN

proof.text: On an etale scheme chart of G, the composite with G -> Spec Omega is unramified if that structure map is unramified, by composition with an etale morphism. Conversely the identity chart tests the structure map itself. The slice-presheaf equivalence identifies restriction to the dual-number test scheme D with the literal cartesian presheaf fibre product of X. Naturality for Spec Omega -> D identifies reduction to the identity with infinitesimalReduction followed by the automorphism equalling infinitesimalReduction; naturality for D -> Spec Omega identifies the constant identity point with the identity automorphism. Bijectivity gives both implications.

theorem ProperCurveModuli.exists_stabilizer_comparison {k : Type u} [Field k]
    (Ω : Type u) [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω] (a : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ Spec (.of k))
    (X : ProperCurveFamily (Over.mk a)) :
    ∃ (x : BasedFunctor (discreteModuli (yoneda.obj (Over.mk a)))
        (ProperCurveModuli.category (Spec (.of k))))
      (G : Grp (Over (Spec (.of Ω)))) (Z : AlgebraicSpace (Spec (.of k)))
      (p : Z.obj.obj ⟶ yoneda.obj (Over.mk a)),
      LocallyOfFiniteType G.X.hom ∧ QuasiCompact G.X.hom ∧
      IsModuliAutomorphismSpace (Over.mk a) x Z p ∧
      (∀ U : OpenModuliSubstack (ProperCurveModuli.category (Spec (.of k))),
        U.property ⟨Over.mk a, X⟩ ↔
          ∃ y : BasedFunctor (discreteModuli (yoneda.obj (Over.mk a))) U.category,
            Nonempty (ModuliTwoIso
              (y.comp (fullModuliInclusion (ProperCurveModuli.category (Spec (.of k)))
                U.property)) x)) ∧
      (SpaceMapIsUnramified Z (Over.mk a) p ↔ IsUnramified G.X.hom) ∧
      ((∀ v : Spec (.of (DualNumber Ω)) ⟶ G.X.left,
        v ≫ G.X.hom = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap Ω (DualNumber Ω))) →
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (TrivSqZeroExt.fstHom Ω Ω Ω).toRingHom) ≫ v =
          η[G.X].left →
        v = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap Ω (DualNumber Ω))) ≫ η[G.X].left) ↔
        ProperCurveFamily.HasTrivialInfinitesimalAutomorphisms Ω a X.projection)
